semiconductor_relevance: High — Dalton Corporation provides specialized equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Dalton Corporation manufactures equipment for key semiconductor manufacturing processes, including washing and cleaning for assembly and packaging, substrate cleaning and drying, and fab processing. They also offer coat, develop, and resist processing equipment, as well as etching, stripping, and ashing solutions, both dry and wet. Their focus on sustainability is evident in their use of biomass technology and environmentally friendly ozone purification.
capabilities: Washing and cleaning equipment for assembly and packaging
Coat, develop, and resist processing equipment
Etching, stripping, and ashing equipment (dry and wet)

regional_presence.Japan: Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Dalton Corporation is strategically positioned to serve the semiconductor industry with its manufacturing and sales operations.
